verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway itself is self-hosted, so residency is inherently user-controlled, but for its SaaS/AI offerings the only residency-relevant evidence is the observation that Konnect's MCP server has separate us/eu/au/in regional endpoints, implying multi-region deployment options rather than an explicit 'choose your region' data-residency feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation on selecting/storing account or AI-Gateway data in a specific region, and confirmation that Gateway/Konnect data (not just MCP traffic) residency is user-selectable.
